component.name: Ghastty
component.summary: A fast, feature-rich terminal emulator (Qt frontend)

description.p: Ghastty is a Qt frontend for the Ghostty terminal core: a terminal emulator that differentiates itself by being fast, feature-rich, and native. While there are many excellent terminal emulators available, they all force you to choose between speed, features, or native UIs. Ghostty provides all three.
